title: A Semiparametric Real-Time GARCH Model with Nonstationary Variance
abstract: arXiv:2610.36739v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a semiparametric real-time GARCH (SRT-GARCH) model that combines a smooth deterministic long-run volatility component with a stationary short-run process driven by contemporaneous return innovations. The model accommodates gradual changes in unconditional variance while allowing short-run volatility to respond directly to current information rather than relying solely on lagged observations. We derive the variance normalization, conditional moments, and closed-form conditional density of the model. For estimation, we develop a two-step procedure that combines kernel smoothing with conditional Gaussian maximum likelihood. Under Gaussian innovations and mild regularity conditions, we establish consistency and asymptotic normality of the short-run parameter estimator. The analysis exploits geometric moment contraction to control serial dependence and shows that estimating the long-run component adds a positive semidefinite rank-o

translated_title: 一种具有非平稳方差的半参数实时GARCH模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种半参数实时GARCH（SRT-GARCH）模型，该模型将平滑的确定性长期波动率成分与由同期收益创新驱动的平稳短期过程相结合。该模型能够适应无条件方差的渐进变化，同时允许短期波动率直接对当前信息做出反应，而不仅仅依赖于滞后观测值。我们推导了该模型的方差归一化、条件矩以及闭式条件密度。在估计方面，我们开发了一种将核平滑与条件高斯极大似然相结合的两步估计程序。在高斯创新和温和的正则性条件下，我们建立了短期参数估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。该分析利用几何矩收缩来控制序列相关性，并表明对长期成分的估计会增加一个半正定的秩一（rank-one）调整项。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合平滑确定性长期波动率成分与由同期收益创新驱动的短期过程的半参数实时GARCH（SRT-GARCH）模型，并开发了基于核平滑的两步估计方法，证明了估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a semiparametric real-time GARCH (SRT-GARCH) model that combines a smooth deterministic long-run volatility component with a stationary short-run process driven by contemporaneous return innovations, and develops a two-step kernel-based estimation procedure with established consistency and asymptotic normality.
